title: Mertie Batt Crime Scene

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Come for a closer look?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come for a closer look?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Poor old Auntie Batt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Poor old Auntie Batt.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: She was everyone's aunt. Least it felt that way, sometimes. Meridian Market's gonna be dark without her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was everyone's aunt. Least it felt that way, sometimes. Meridian Market's gonna be dark without her.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Yeah. Just like she didn't deserve to live in debt her whole life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Just like she didn't deserve to live in debt her whole life.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Nothing. This guy's working cleaner than an Erasure Tech.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing. This guy's working cleaner than an Erasure Tech.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You'd prefer it to be someone else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'd prefer it to be someone else?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Knock yourself out. I gotta take a break anyway. This is killing me today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Knock yourself out. I gotta take a break anyway. This is killing me today.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Must be nice to be so sure about who deserves to die. Now, if you'll excuse me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Must be nice to be so sure about who deserves to die. Now, if you'll excuse me...

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Whatever. I gotta take a break, this is killing me today. Look around all you want. She ain't going nowhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever. I gotta take a break, this is killing me today. Look around all you want. She ain't going nowhere.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I gotta take a break, this is killing me today. Look around all you want. She ain't going nowhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I gotta take a break, this is killing me today. Look around all you want. She ain't going nowhere.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I'm not sure. This one really got to me. Do you think he's right? This Aseptic lad. Some people think he's doing the right thing but I'm not sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure. This one really got to me. Do you think he's right? This Aseptic lad. Some people think he's doing the right thing but I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I've seen it all doing this job. Maulings so bad you don't know what's what anymore. "Oh is this Rooster Soup or is it a bit of ex-person".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've seen it all doing this job. Maulings so bad you don't know what's what anymore. "Oh is this Rooster Soup or is it a bit of ex-person".

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You know what Shoku, I think you might be right. It might be time to rince the mop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what Shoku, I think you might be right. It might be time to rince the mop.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: If there's one thing this job has taught me, it's how to clean up after myself. I think it's time I apply that to something useful. Hey, maybe I'll see you around. Thanks for the words.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If there's one thing this job has taught me, it's how to clean up after myself. I think it's time I apply that to something useful. Hey, maybe I'll see you around. Thanks for the words.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: The smell, it just becomes a part of you eventually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The smell, it just becomes a part of you eventually.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: But there's something about this guy. I mean you can't call it beautiful but I mean look at it... Look at me getting all emotional.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But there's something about this guy. I mean you can't call it beautiful but I mean look at it... Look at me getting all emotional.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh no. Is that...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh no. Is that...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She was your aunt?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was your aunt?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mertie didn't deserve this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mertie didn't deserve this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you found any clues this time? Anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you found any clues this time? Anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you found any clues this time? Anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you found any clues this time? Anything?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mind if I look around?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mind if I look around?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But why Mertie?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But why Mertie?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Honestly? Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Honestly? Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not what I meant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not what I meant.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where are you going?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you... ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you... ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's never an excuse for murder.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's never an excuse for murder.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's never an excuse for murder.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's never an excuse for murder.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If it takes the fight to the corps, maybe some good can come from it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it takes the fight to the corps, maybe some good can come from it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If it takes the fight to the corps, maybe some good can come from it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If it takes the fight to the corps, maybe some good can come from it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It sounds like you need a break.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds like you need a break.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It sounds like you need a break.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It sounds like you need a break.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about your debts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about your debts?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're welcome.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds awful!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds awful!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the worst part of it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the worst part of it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What's the worst part of it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What's the worst part of it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it.
